tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description begins with 'Use this skill for...' which is imperative phrasing, and enumerates a long explicit list of symptom-based trigger contexts (avails not filling, slate, VAST parse failures, timeouts, playback error codes, channel STOPPED, schedule gaps, etc.) so the agent can match on symptom even if the user doesn't name MediaTailor directly. It also clearly scopes out adjacent skills (aws-mediapackage-investigate, aws-medialive-investigate, aws-media-spec-reference, aws-media-cloudfront-investigate), which is a strong pushy/boundary-setting practice. It is dense but stays within a reasonable paragraph length for the breadth of scenarios covered.
tests.evidence: Use this skill for AWS Elemental MediaTailor SSAI (server-side ad insertion) and Channel Assembly. Use for ad symptoms: avails not filling, slate or source content instead of ads, empty VAST/VMAP, ADS timeouts or errors...

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body stays domain-specific throughout — it never explains general concepts like what HTTP status codes are or what CloudWatch is, instead jumping into MediaTailor-specific facts (PercentEnabled defaults, dimension discovery, fill-rate formulas). It is dense but every sentence carries non-obvious, specific information.
tests.evidence: "LogConfiguration.PercentEnabled: defaults to 0, and anything below 100 samples sessions, so a missing log line is not evidence of health."

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: Detailed tables, full metric catalogs, log event catalogs, and error code tables are consistently pushed into references/ files and only summarized or linked in the body. The body keeps decision logic (e.g., the three-way fill rate split) but defers the bulk reference data.
tests.evidence: "Table: [Step S4: Player-facing status triage ...](references/lookup-tables.md#step-s4-player-facing-status-triage-only-if-the-complaint-carries-an-http-status). Load it when you run this step."

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: All eight files in references/ are linked via markdown links in the body: ssai-log-catalog.md, lookup-tables.md, ssai-fill-behavior.md, ssai-metric-reference.md, playback-errors-and-limits.md, channel-assembly-procedure.md, report-outlines.md, and channel-assembly-checklist.md.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link is paired with a specific trigger condition for when to load it, rather than a generic 'see for details' phrase.
tests.evidence: "load the \"Observability preconditions\" section of [references/ssai-log-catalog.md](references/ssai-log-catalog.md) when you need the exact field, default, cap or documented trap"

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference file paths use relative paths of the form references/<filename>.md with no absolute paths or traversal.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile operations (log precheck gates, pagination flags, write-operation restrictions) are given exact prescriptive commands, while diagnostic reasoning (fill rate branch, symptom-to-step mapping) explains the why and allows flexible investigation paths.
tests.evidence: "That is a write operation outside this skill's read-only scope: never run it, report it as the operator action."

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: Where choices exist (e.g., logging strategies, fill-rate computation), the skill designates a clear primary approach and treats alternatives as conditional branches rather than an undifferentiated menu.
tests.evidence: "Treat list-metrics output as authoritative, never the docs."

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable investigative procedure (symptom routing table, step sequence, three-way diagnostic branches) applicable to any MediaTailor investigation instance, not a one-off task.
tests.evidence: "Then map the symptom to where the answer usually lives. Start at \"First stop\"; escalate only if it does not explain the symptom."

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill has an extensive, dedicated gotchas-equivalent section covering non-obvious observability traps (sampling, log gating, cache TTL behavior) that would otherwise mislead the agent.
tests.evidence: "This is the dominant design fact for MediaTailor and the most common reason an investigation cannot reach a conclusion. ... Five gates decide what a log can prove."

tests.name: Templates and outputs missing
tests.reasoning: The skill explicitly provides a report outline reference for structured findings output, satisfying the need for templated output in this report-producing skill.
tests.evidence: "Use the matching report outline (SSAI or Channel Assembly) in [references/report-outlines.md](references/report-outlines.md) when compiling the report; load it at this step only."

tests.name: Templates and outputs must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The only template-like content in the body (the DATA GAP format and the origin handoff example) is short (under 10 lines), and the actual full report outlines are deferred to references/report-outlines.md.
